governing_constraints.requirement: Retain checked field reads, selected output and mutation/predicate/return construction facts and call/route links. Existing tokens or aggregate digests cannot replace structured supported facts. Unknown aliases/feasibility remain explicit.

required_refinements.title: Specify total type lookup and normalize compiler-local names in values, not just IDs
required_refinements.gap: The recipe proposes source/range-matched inferred types and excludes offsets/NodeIds from stable identity, but does not define missing/ambiguous matches or compiler-local type-name values. A checked page expression returns before appending its outer InferredExpression. Route whole path/header expressions can infer __route_path_<offset>/__route_headers_<offset>; inline Object declarations use __jadpo_<owner>_<counter>. Emitting these raw names in values defeats source-contract stability even when IDs contain no offsets. TypeCheckResult also exposes display strings, not row-origin bindings or a complete public typed IR.
correction: Match internally by exact source+expression range; coalesce identical duplicate observations and explicitly classify missing or distinct conflicting observations. Never skip a valid source fact or reject a valid checked page solely because no outer inferred-expression row exists.

For page result and declared callable/route/output/field contracts retain the independently checked AST contract reference even when expression inference evidence is absent. Use distinct evidence labels such as checked_declared_contract and observed_inferred_display; do not fabricate an inferred row.

Normalize known compiler-generated route/inline type shapes to structural checked owner/surface/field paths or emit a precise unresolved synthetic-type reason. Do not copy embedded offsets/counters into IDs or semantic contract values; do not blindly rewrite an authored name by prefix.

Preserve exact authored qualified/generic/nullable field type/reference and declaration tokens independently of inferred display. Display strings do not establish database origin, secret-flow classification or full resolved representation.

acceptance_examples.expect: Retain TodoPage result, TodoView projection, TodoCursor and ordered created_at/id tuple plus predicates even if the page expression has no inferred row; outer attempt may have an observation and must not be confused with the child page.

acceptance_examples.source: tests/compile/pass/165_route_query_headers.jadpo with a checked inline var all_headers = headers; analogous whole path binding on a route declaring path fields
acceptance_examples.expect: Whitespace or an unrelated earlier declaration must not change field-contract shape solely through __route_* offsets. Exact whole-value boundary and route header/path declaration shape stay visible without row-origin inference.

Inline record type identities use owning declaration/field structural address, not parser inline_type_counter. Add an earlier unrelated inline Object; equivalent referenced shapes must not silently acquire different opaque counter identities.

required_refinements.title: Explicitly extract ordinary patch-derived writes, not only literal/derived changes
required_refinements.gap: The recipe enumerates update literal and supplied-conditional fields but ordinary patch: input has no corresponding literal or conditional_changes rows. Checker-defined optional input-field→same-name entity-field mappings are already supported facts. If omitted, a valid patch-only update could falsely expose no field writes.
correction: Add explicit patch binding/type and checked input-declaration field→entity-field contract rows. Each row retains optional/supplied condition and declared nominal contract reference; it does not prove where input data originated or that a runtime field was supplied.
Preserve absent versus present-null for nullable optional fields; record empty-patch failure separately. Do not substitute patch != null for supplied.
Derived conditional changes retain their own value tokens and exact supplied path; preserve checker overlap rejection and missing/conflict bindings.

If a complex alias cannot be statically associated with a checked patch declaration, retain the whole-patch boundary and precise unresolved reason instead of an empty write set. This is not a requirement to implement alias/SSA analysis.

acceptance_examples.expect: Customer.email <- PatchCustomer.email and Customer.nickname <- PatchCustomer.nickname are conditional on each field being supplied even though changes/conditional_changes are empty; empty/missing/conflict failures remain distinct; nickname's explicit null is not omission.

Todo.due_at patch mapping plus Todo.reminder_sent_at <- none when input.due_at supplied are both present; changing the derived value or supplied path changes a source-contract decision without requiring a different entity-level update witness.
Invalid supported patch shapes produce no checked subject; do not weaken the checker to build examples.

required_refinements.title: Define declaration catalogue and owner/header coverage explicitly
required_refinements.gap: The recipe says entity/output fields and walks root/entity/inline bodies. Checked output contracts also use Value records (including type X = Object lowering), input records, enum payload targets and header-level receiver/mutation guards. These must not be missed by a narrow entity/output-only index or a nested-callable traversal that the AST does not have.
correction: Use flattened Declaration::Callable entries and their already-qualified name.text directly for Function/Action/Query; owner is metadata only, never prepended again. Inline owners use checked method/path route identity; RecordDeclaration has no callable vector.

Index the checked field-bearing declarations required by constructors, patch inputs and output boundaries: Record kinds Entity/Value/Input/Output and constructed enum payload fields; named scalar Type aliases retain their exact nominal reference/constraints rather than being treated as field-bearing records. Reuse checked synthetic structural shape handling from FOP-01.

Carry callable declared parameters/return/failures and applicable receiver/mutation_guard/freshness/consistency headers as context or explicit bound references. In particular guard: reload/revision is supported checked data, not merely a branch condition.

Retain query cardinality and predicate/key field; output/return and missing/empty/conflict trigger kinds remain distinct. Generated lifecycle mutation effects can point to the existing checked lifecycle contract; do not derive executed writes from the transition name alone.

acceptance_examples.expect: Owners are Customer.contact, Customer.change_email and Customer.by_email once; receiver value and guard revision retained. A valid revision→reload change gets an exact guard contract delta even when update target and body are unchanged. Root rename_customer and inline route wrappers have independent owners and checked call links.

PaymentOutcome.paid.receipt_id/paid_at constructor fields and match-arm symbolic pattern are retained; no forced primitive or enum-base collapse. Whole optional values remain boundaries, not proof of safe projection.

accepted_recipe_directions: Add separate source-contract facet; preserve existing impact.fields inventory/status/facts.
Extract exact checked AST expression tokens, predicates, literal mutations, transitions, constructor target fields and whole-value boundaries.
Retain checked declared nominal contract reference separately from origin; note.title, an input typed PrivateNote.title or shared Text never establishes a database-source edge.
Keep branch/arm, supplied, missing/empty/conflict and propagated/handled-failure conditions symbolic; no solver/runtime condition satisfaction.
Record page/include/cursor as checked declaration/projection contracts, never executed joins.
Join owners to HTTP entries using checked semantic endpoints and deterministic may-call witnesses. Unreachable/standalone owners still retain contracts with explicit no-route-link facts.
Stable tuple/structural-address approach is proportionate provided its version and insertion/rename limits are explicit.
Exact route response contracts and individual decisions first; no new actor admission/effect scenario invented.
Paired independently expected semantic fixtures and fresh-export rehashed omissions; no self-derived expected facts.

identity_order_conditions.identity_recipe: Recommend a versioned canonical tuple [owner kind, checked owner identity, structural address, contract kind, target/field]. Encode/hash canonical tuples, not ambiguous delimiter concatenation. This is an implementation refinement, not an invented product-authority choice.
identity_order_conditions.addresses: Use typed child roles such as body/statement/return/value/construction/field, then/else, match arm/pattern, positional argument/named argument, page predicate/order, rejection branch. Statement ordinal is source-structural only; adding/reordering statements may conservatively remove/add identities. Do not advertise durable insertion/rename identity.
identity_order_conditions.sorting: Sort semantic sets of contract rows, field catalogues and route links; preserve ordered statement/argument/evaluation paths, page.order and cursor_fields tuples, expression tokens and witnesses. Sorting a keyset order/cursor tuple changes semantics.
identity_order_conditions.absence: Checked no-contracts is explicit [] with an appropriate checked scope; whole-value/unresolved edges are rows with reason, not [] or a safe/proved claim. Invalid source rejects the entire subject. Missing lookup evidence is not missing source syntax.
identity_order_conditions.insertion_guardrail: No byte-offset/NodeId/counter escape through emitted type names or structural aliases; exact source/provenance hashes may still change under whitespace or source edits, as intended.

Do not feed a field-response delta into route_actor_sources or route_actor_constraints_changed, and do not invent a terminal effect to force a scenario.
acceptance: Pair a public effectless pure response with literal v1→v2, same route/auth/policy/calls: field/output source-contract and route response link delta must be visible; no new admission/effect scenario or changed existing scenario meaning/ID.
Pair effectful response selection with unchanged auth/policy and identical entity/service terminal witnesses: response contracts change without an invented actor change.
Use fixture68 CreatedItem/POST success created and DELETE success no_content: record success/output presence/absence and whole Unit boundary accurately; no fake response fields for204.
Freeze existing actor/effect/admission fixture assertions/IDs and require their conformance to remain unchanged by adding this facet. Any future response-scenario discriminator needs separate review.
route_response_vs_admission.limits: This plan review does not approve current actor-route implementation or claim output disclosure can never affect policy. A field-policy change may legitimately alter checked policy constraints; the acceptance pairs isolate pure response-only changes.
